notice: 界面红色统一换成品牌绿（胜利页、击破、教程、关卡奖励等）；大招特写改用小技能立绘 + 剪报字大招名，判定改为三连拍（判定更宽，三拍合计评分）；应急守护可用时像心跳一样跳动提醒；主界面两位角色循环播放小动作视频，点她切换另一段。
unityBuild: Unity 6000.6.0f1 WebGL R129: Brand1025 green replaces P5 red on UI plates/bands/badges; BattleUltimateShow1020 cut-in uses the authored skill cut-in art + ransom ult name; UltimateBeatChallenge1025 (3 beats, ±90/±200 ms); Heartbeat1025 on the guard badge; PsdHomeIdolVideo1025 stacked-alpha lobby idol clips (StreamingAssets/LobbyIdols) with UIStackedAlpha shader.

validation.iosSimulator: Lobby idol clips loop and swap on tap (Catalena + Lilith); ult cut-in + 3 beats with GOOD/COMBO; guard badge heartbeat ring; victory band/continue button green.

knownLimits: 伤害数字、低血量等危险提示和种族特效颜色仍保留红色；粉色点缀未改。
